answer_text: - IPS allowlist rules differ from firewall rules in how they match: IPS allowlist rules are all applied to matching traffic, and each matching rule can generate an event. Firewall rules, by contrast, are evaluated in order and only the first matching rule is applied. - To create a rule from a block/IPS block action, you can manually add an IPS allowlist rule (the block action is addressed by allowing the traffic you saw blocked). For example, set Signature ID to Any to allow all matching traffic, click Apply (the rule is added to the IPS allowlist), and then Save to persist it.
